## Checklist

- [ ] The commit messages follow the [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/)
      specification and are signed off (`git commit -s`), see the
      [contributing guidelines](https://github.com/coco-tools/cococheck#contributing).

      configuration, or the rules.
